name: contextiq
description: Local AI system for answering questions about meeting transcripts

tools.name: search_transcripts
tools.description: Search meeting transcripts and chat logs for relevant information. Returns context chunks with source metadata.

n_results.description: Number of relevant chunks to retrieve (default: 5)

tools.name: ask_about_transcripts
tools.description: Ask a natural language question and get an AI-generated answer based on meeting transcripts and chat logs. Uses RAG to retrieve relevant context and LLM to generate answer.

question.description: The question to ask about the transcripts
